zh-Hans: 你的弱点，是还没克服对右侧的恐惧。说白了，就是右弯跑得太差！
en: Your weakness is that you haven't overcome your fear of the right side. Put simply, you're terrible at right-hand corners!

zh-Hans: 试试你到底有多少本事吧。
en: Let's see just what you're capable of.

zh-Hans: 这实力简直难以招架，近距离一看，还是让人不得不服！
en: What overwhelming ability. Seeing it up close leaves me impressed all over again!

zh-Hans: 令人战栗，真是场绝妙的游戏。
en: What a thrill. This is a magnificent game.

zh-Hans: 前轮的抓地突然变差了。
en: The front tires have suddenly lost their bite.

zh-Hans: 但愿你这份从容，不会在后半程要了你的命。
en: I hope that confidence doesn't prove fatal in the second half.

zh-Hans: 看来得稍微修正一下模拟。仅此而已，结果不会变。
en: I'll need to adjust my simulation slightly. That's all. The outcome won't change.

zh-Hans: 轮胎就算衰退一点，我的技术也不会出纰漏。
en: A little tire wear won't put a flaw in my technique.

zh-Hans: 真让人吃惊，他还在进化！

en: A major miscalculation. How could this happen?

zh-Hans: 跟得上的话，就跟上来吧。
en: If you can keep up, then follow me.

zh-Hans: 能遇上让我有这种感觉的对手，真令人高兴。
en: I'm glad to have found an opponent who makes me feel this way.

zh-Hans: 身为车手的热血，好久没这样沸腾了。
en: It's been a long time since my racer's blood stirred like this.

zh-Hans: 既然到了前面，再被咬住可就麻烦了。
en: Now that I'm ahead, letting him latch on would be troublesome.

zh-Hans: 趁他还没缓过来，一口气拉开，定下胜负！
en: I'll pull away before he recovers and settle this!

zh-Hans: 真正的较量，现在才开始！

en: I'll be the one to win.

zh-Hans: 令人战栗，绝妙的游戏。孤注一掷，机会只有一次！
en: What a thrill. A magnificent game. One chance, all or nothing!

zh-Hans: 抓住那一闪一现、针眼般大小的突破口！
en: I'll strike at that fleeting opening, as narrow as the eye of a needle!

zh-Hans: 现在的我，还不会输给任何人。今天就全力跑到底！
en: I'm not ready to lose to anyone yet. Today, I'm going all out!

zh-Hans: 就用这一战，检验我的真正实力。
en: This battle will show what I'm truly capable of.

zh-Hans: 赌上山路专家的骄傲，这一战我会奉陪到底！
en: I'll fight with my pride as a street specialist on the line!
